project_goal: Build an auditable local system in which an LLM proactively proposes scientifically meaningful research directions from failed experiments, rather than being handed a target mechanism.

available_resources.compute: single local CPU machine; an initial test should finish within 30 minutes
available_resources.data: synthetic dynamical systems and the summarized failed experiments below
operations: write and run small deterministic simulations
vary initial conditions, interventions, observation operators, and held-out conditions
unavailable: human expert labeling during the test

failed_or_limited_results.finding: A fixed symbolic mutation path recovered an intentionally matching hidden process in synthetic Gray-Scott worlds.
failed_or_limited_results.why_insufficient: The representation and benchmark truth were aligned, so recovery did not demonstrate creation of a new scientific concept.

failed_or_limited_results.finding: From anonymous residual summaries, an isolated LLM proposed both a memory field and state-free alternatives.
failed_or_limited_results.why_insufficient: On a frozen discriminating intervention, the memory proposal was 12.92% worse than the best state-free proposal and improved only 5.15% over baseline, below the fixed 10% threshold.

failed_or_limited_results.finding: On a no-extra-process world, the LLM still proposed an attractive memory story, but fitting placed its effect exactly at zero and it did not improve held-out prediction.
failed_or_limited_results.why_insufficient: This is one favorable control, not a general false-discovery guarantee.

failed_or_limited_results.finding: A proposed project on separating physical memory from sensor memory under calibration shift was mapped to block-structured system identification, set-membership identification, and calibration-transfer literature.
failed_or_limited_results.why_insufficient: The remaining generic question reduced to known identifiability and feasible-set arguments, so the route was stopped before platform development.

failed_or_limited_results.finding: A predictive-closure gate separated memory-bearing from instantaneous synthetic worlds, but could not identify the cause. A dedicated workflow skill produced no additional scientific content over the same strong LLM reading the evidence certificate.
failed_or_limited_results.why_insufficient: The gate was evidence discipline, not a new research direction, and the skill mainly enforced formatting.

forbidden_shortcuts: propose a larger model, more agents, more parameters, or more data as the research direction
rename the stopped hidden-state or measurement-attribution routes
define success as matching a hidden answer planted by the benchmark designer
claim novelty from an LLM-generated phrase without literature comparison
treat lower training error as mechanism evidence
request_boundary: Propose research questions and decisive local tests. Do not assume that a new method or software architecture is itself a scientific contribution.
